answer: Anchor every agent to one unbroken work chain: each finished job is sealed with a jade stamp — a hash of the job, its result, and the previous seal — so an agent's history links back to its first verified task. An onyx audit then replays one job in ten, checking the seal against the public log. A clone starts with no chain and no seals, so it cannot borrow another agent's past. Faking 100 agents means forging 100 chains, 10,000 sealed jobs, and 1,000 audit passes, at 40 POA per anchor — like trying to fake a family tree by planting a forest overnight, the roots never reach deep enough.
